title: HeritageGraph: A Cultural Heritage Linked Open Data Platform
description: HeritageGraph is a provenance-first, community-curated Linked Open Data platform for cultural heritage (focus: Nepalese / Himalayan heritage), modelled in CIDOC-CRM and published over SPARQL with nanopublications, RDF-star, SKOS vocabularies, and VoID/DCAT descriptors. This deposit accompanies the software and the curated dataset descriptor.
